question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Purify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"purify"** means to remove contaminants from something, making it clean and pure. (शुद्ध करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The water was purified before being used for drinking.
 
 
 
• **"Pollute"** refers to making something dirty or contaminated, especially with harmful or poisonous substances. (प्रदूषित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Factories that pollute the air are a major concern for environmentalists.
